input.cv_text: Wanjiru Kamau is a data analyst in Nairobi with 4 years of experience. She is proficient in Python, SQL and Power BI. She has worked with Excel dashboards for county health data.
Otieno Ochieng is a backend developer at a Kisumu fintech. He is experienced in Django, PostgreSQL and REST APIs. He has built M-Pesa integrations using the Daraja API.
Akinyi Atieno is a frontend engineer. She is skilled in React, TypeScript and Figma. She worked with Tailwind CSS on an online shop for a Mombasa retailer.
Kiprono Korir is a cloud engineer in Eldoret. He is experienced in AWS, Terraform and Linux administration. He is certified in Kubernetes.
Muthoni Wambui is a project manager. She is proficient in Jira, stakeholder management and budgeting. She has led delivery teams using Scrum.
Barasa Wafula is a mobile developer. He is skilled in Kotlin, Flutter and Firebase. He worked with the Google Maps API on a boda boda delivery app.
Amina Hassan is a machine learning engineer. She is experienced in PyTorch, scikit-learn and NLP. She has worked with Kiswahili text classification datasets.
Chebet Jeptoo is an accountant in Nakuru. She is proficient in QuickBooks, Excel and tax compliance. She has experience in auditing for SACCOs.
